news.analysis: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.
news.contents: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.title: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions

news.contents: Jacksonville Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence should be among the top fantasy quarterbacks in Week 8 against the Indianapolis Colts. The Jaguars are coming off a Week 7 bye and a close Week 6 loss to the Houston Texans. They did score 31 points, so despite the loss, Lawrence and the Jaguars offense should feel good heading into a matchup with another division rival. The Colts are on a three-game losing streak and starting to trade off some of their veterans. The 4-2 Jaguars are heading in ...
news.title: Trevor Lawrence Among Top QB Options Against Skidding Colts

news.analysis: Swift pulled off the hat trick on Monday night, getting into the end zone three different times in a big win over Seattle. Outside of that he wasn't very efficient and didn't get a lot of work as a receiver, so while his fantasy total was very good, it didn't quite reach dominant levels. He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.
news.contents: D'Andre Swift rushed the ball 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns while adding two catches for ten yards through the air in Monday night's 24-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.title: D'Andre Swift scores three touchdowns in win Monday

news.contents: Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift rushed for 69 yards and three touchdowns on 27 carries in his team's 34-17 Monday Night Football victory over the Seattle Seahawks. He added ten yards and two receptions on three targets. Swift's efficiency tapered off against what's been a staunch Seattle defense, but he rewarded fantasy managers with his second hat trick thus far. The 27-year-old is up to a sterling seven touchdowns over his last four appearances, and set a new career high with his ...
news.title: D'Andre Swift Stays Hot Despite Inefficient Outing

news.analysis: Brown did most of his damage in the passing game in the thrilling win over Tennessee. More importantly, he out-touched Samaje Perine 20-to-five in the contest after Perine had been cutting into his workload in recent weeks. Brown will continue to be a low-end RB1/high-end RB2 as he prepares to face the Falcons in Week 9.
news.contents: Chase Brown carried the ball 12 times for 55 yards while catching eight of his nine targets for 46 yards and losing a fumble in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.title: Chase Brown catches eight passes in Week 8

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals running back Chase Brown rushed for 55 yards on 12 carries during Sunday's Week 8 win over the Tennessee Titans. He also caught eight of his nine targets for an additional 46 receiving yards. Finally, he also lost a fumble. Brown turned in a modest rushing stat line, but he had a terrific performance in the passing game. His eight catches were particularly useful in half-PPR and full-PPR leagues, where he used his receiving volume to post double-digit fantasy points. The ...
news.title: Chase Brown Handles Enormous Receiving Volume in Win

news.analysis: Lamb was held mostly in check Sunday, finishing under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last three contests. The wideout remains locked in as an elite WR1 option against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.
news.contents: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 11 targets for 58 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.

news.analysis: It was known that Wilson would see a reduction in workload this week with Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price making their return from injury, but it was shocking to see that he did not log even a single opportunity over the course of the night. The team entirely wrote him out of the game plan, which burned any fantasy managers who dared start him after his quality performance in Week 7. He may not be an involved member of this offense moving forward, in which case he would easily be safe to drop.

news.analysis: Charbonnet made his season debut for the Seahawks on Monday night after missing an extended period of time recovering from a significant knee injury. He didn't make headlines in his first game back, however, racking up just 29 total yards on his nine touches over the course of the night. He will likely continue to get more involved as he continues to ramp back up to a full workload over the next couple of weeks.

news.analysis: Loveland saw good involvement on Monday night. He was tied for the most targets and receptions out of anyone on the team, and he was able to turn his seven catches into 65 yards against the Seahawks. Fantasy managers should feel good about his chances at a breakout over the back half of the season.

news.title: Colston Loveland catches seven passes Monday

news.contents: Chicago Bears tight end Colston Loveland caught seven passes for 65 yards on nine targets in a 34-17 win over the hosting Seattle Seahawks in Week 8. Monday marked the second straight game in which the former Michigan Wolverine led or tied for the team lead in targets, and it was the fourth time in his last five that he'd recorded at least six grabs. Loveland's fourth-quarter fumble is the only ding on his ledger in an otherwise strong outing against an imposing Seattle defense. Back in fantasy...
news.title: Colston Loveland Emerging as a Consistent Presence in Chicago's Attack

news.analysis: Boerkircher remains a block-first tight end for the Jaguars, but the rookie has now found the end zone in two consecutive games. He scored on a ridiculous catch from one yard out in Week 6, then on a 31-yard pass Sunday afternoon. With just seven receptions overall, however, Boerkircher is not on the redraft radar.
news.contents: Nate Boerkircher caught his only target for a 31-yard touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.title: Nate Boerkircher hits paydirt again in Week 8
